newsitem.title: UK: Manchester Utd shares drift lower.
newsitem.headline: Manchester Utd shares drift lower.

text.p: Shares in football club Manchester United Plc continued to fall on Wednesday as investors waited for news of major signings.
Shares in the club were down 15 1/2 pence at 651 pence, with about 30,000 shares changing hands.
A market-maker in the stock said there had been a number of small sellers of the stock, which has slipped back over the past week after a strong run since early June.
On Friday Manchester's arch-rivals Liverpool announced they had signed Manchester's former midfield star and England player Paul Ince from Italy's Internazionale for the new season.
"Manchester have had no really big signings and people are waiting to see some," the market-maker said.
